completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The pilot did not set the friction lock on the throttle before hand propping the engine, so when the engine started and rpm increased, the airplane moved forward and hit the credit card machine [20191230X15852:probable_cause][20191230X15852:analysis]. The parking brake also malfunctioned: the airplane moved even after the brake was applied, and the reason for that malfunction could not be determined [20191230X15852:analysis][20191230X15852:probable_cause]. The pilot also did not verify that the airplane would stay put with the parking brake set [20191230X15852:analysis]. The throttle's friction lock was found to be working during the FAA inspector's examination [20191230X15852:analysis]."}
